description: This file defines the `JavelinGuardrail` class, which extends `CustomGuardrail` to integrate Javelin guardrail checks within a FastAPI-based application. It includes methods for calling the external Javelin API asynchronously, handling request pre-processing, and managing guardrail responses, including blocking requests if necessary.
